primary_aggregate_definition: event-macro mean across deletion, temporal, and update; each event has equal weight
secondary_aggregate_definition: micro mean across all eligible evaluated base-condition observations

balanced_event_robustness.rule: temporal uses all 169; deletion/update use source-aware deterministic hash ranking with seed 42 and no model outputs

analysis_policy_statement: Primary aggregation, secondary aggregation, balanced-event robustness, and OAKS cluster-robustness rules were frozen before model inference on the final main cohort.
